# Heart Cadence Inc.

> Heart Cadence Inc. (HCI) is a Canadian consultancy based in Brantford, Ontario. We help small and mid-sized Canadian businesses choose, set up and run the technology their teams and customers rely on. We also help vendors and subcontractors get ready for and bid on Government contracts.

We are not tied to any one brand. We compare options, manage the setup with the client and stay their point of contact. Consultations are in English.

## Services

- [Technology and customer experience services](https://heartcadence.com/services/): customer experience, service desk and IT service management (ITSM), phones and contact centre (UCaaS and CCaaS), networks and connectivity, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure, mobility and IoT
  - [Service desk and ITSM consulting](https://heartcadence.com/services/service-desk-itsm/)
  - [Business phones and contact centre](https://heartcadence.com/services/phones-contact-centre/)
  - [Customer experience consulting](https://heartcadence.com/services/customer-experience/)
  - [Cybersecurity for small and mid-sized businesses](https://heartcadence.com/services/cybersecurity/)
- [Government contract support](https://heartcadence.com/government/): procurement readiness, and bid and proposal development
- [How we work](https://heartcadence.com/how-we-work/): fit call, review, plan, and set up and support

## Company

- [About](https://heartcadence.com/about/): Jason K. McEwan, Founder and Principal Consultant (ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver and Support, ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan and Improve). Rory Stennett, Director, Client Experience and Growth.
- [Technology providers](https://heartcadence.com/technology-providers/): the technology providers we work with. We are an authorized ManageEngine reseller.
